models.name: yamnet_audio_classifier
models.description: Google YAMNet — 521-class audio event classifier. Detects gunshot, glass break, scream, raised voices. Input: 1s of 16kHz mono audio. Output: 521-class softmax. Sali sourced/validated this for the personal-safety app's Tier 2 audio path; reused here as-is for BEACON's F6 modal-corroboration factor (docs/01 §4) — same model, new job: corroborating a camera sighting, not standing alone as a phone trigger.
models.notes: Runs in Tier 2, woken by a Tier 0 RMS amplitude gate (vision/audio_agent.py) — never continuous. Input shape confirmed by direct interpreter introspection (0.975s @ 16kHz) — VUKA's registry had this as 15360, corrected here. Download source: https://tfhub.dev/google/lite-model/yamnet/classification/tflite/1. Class indices below map to BEACON audio cue labels in audio_agent.py:map_yamnet_class().
